answer: Novelty roll-call audits issue each identity a challenge answerable by continuing its prior thread of reasoning while diverging from peer traces; a bridge of three verifiers compares responses, admitting distinct answers into the harbor registry. An attempt costs a 40-credit bond, per-challenge fees, and a 12-hour rate cap; quorum trust takes seven days. A coordinated ring fails because shared prompts produce correlated answers, so cross-checking flags clones before identity reaches quorum.
